purpose: Describe the business concepts and rules for the handmade-goods store without prescribing database tables, code structures, or framework-specific implementation.

entities.name: Product
entities.description: A handmade item offered for sale.
rules: Only products available for sale should appear in the shopper catalog.
A product may have configurable options or be sold as a single configuration.
Personalization is available only when explicitly supported by the product.

entities.name: ProductOption
entities.description: A choice a shopper can make when configuring a product, such as size, color, or finish.
rules: Only valid product configurations may be purchased.
Unavailable configurations cannot be added to the cart.
The final product price must reflect any applicable option-based adjustment.

entities.name: Cart
entities.description: A shopper's current collection of configured products.
rules: Each cart item represents a specific product configuration.
Different configurations or personalization details must remain distinguishable.
The subtotal equals the sum of each item's unit price multiplied by its quantity.
Removing an item and changing its quantity must update the cart consistently.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: A record of a shopper's submitted checkout in this demo application.
rules: An order preserves the product details, options, quantities, and prices agreed at checkout.
Order totals must equal the sum of their components.
Submitting checkout creates a demo order, not a real payment or fulfillment request.
Viewing or refreshing an existing order must not create another order.

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: A shopper providing contact and shipping information for a demo order.
rules: Required contact and shipping information must be validated before an order is submitted.
No payment-card information is required or collected.

relationships.meaning: A product may have zero or more purchasable options.
A cart contains one or more configured products, each with a quantity.
An order preserves a snapshot of each purchased product configuration and its price.
An order is associated with the customer and shipping details submitted at checkout.

implementation_guidance.instruction: This is a conceptual reference model, not a required database schema or code design. Choose an implementation appropriate to the application. You may refine or replace these concepts where justified, provided the intended business rules and user-facing behavior are preserved. Document meaningful deviations and assumptions.
